metaTitle: {brand}: game keys for Steam, Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo
metaDescription: Game keys, DLC, gift cards and subscriptions for Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and more. Every key shows its platform and region before you pay, and is delivered to your account after payment is confirmed.

departures.title: Game keys, departing for your account.
departures.leadSearchEmpty: Search game keys for Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and more.
departures.leadPayment: Pay on a hosted card page;
departures.leadDelivery: your key is delivered to your account, usually within minutes after payment is confirmed.
departures.caption: Departures: keys on the board right now
departures.noMatchB: TRY THE TITLE WITHOUT THE EDITION

platforms.title: Choose your platform
platforms.lead: Every key leaves from the platform it activates on. Numbers stay the same, so you can find yours by sight.

theater.title: Watch your key depart
theater.lead: Five short walkthroughs with sample data: checking in a key, paying on the hosted page, your key arriving on your board, redeeming it, and getting help if it doesn't work.

routes.title: Routes
routes.lead: Each genre is a line. Its stops are the platforms with the most keys in that genre.

fares.title: Revised fares
fares.lead: Keys whose price came down. The earlier price is the lowest this key cost here in the {days} days before the cut.
fares.caption: Revised fares: keys with a price cut

gift.title: Gift cards
gift.lead: Store balance for the platform you play on. A card only works on an account set to the card's region.

season.title: Season tickets
season.lead: Subscriptions by length. Prices are for one code; the region is the account region it works with.
season.caption: Subscription prices by service and length

arrivals.title: Arrivals
arrivals.lead: Every key arrives on the platform named on its page. Pick yours to see where to enter it.
arrivals.stillLabel: Sample-data still: a key being redeemed on {name}

gate.title: What passes through us, and what never does
gate.handledKeys: Your keys, stored encrypted and decrypted only when you choose Reveal.
gate.handledKeysPlain: Your keys, kept in your account and shown only when you choose Reveal.
gate.handledOrders: Your orders and invoices, kept for {years} years as the law requires.
gate.neverCard: Card number, expiry date and security code go straight to the payment provider’s hosted page, not to us.
gate.neverBank: Your bank's 3-D Secure check, which happens between you and your bank.
gate.faulty: If a key doesn't work, we replace it, or refund it if no replacement is available.
gate.failed: If a payment fails, you aren't charged.
gate.stillCaption: The 3-D Secure step, shown with sample data
gate.stillLabel: Illustration of a bank's 3-D Secure confirmation, with sample data

terminus.title: Every line ends here. Every key starts here.
terminus.line: Search the whole board, or go straight to your platform.
